# I18N001 pseudo-locale-expansion

A copy key with a length budget still fits once its text grows by the pseudo-locale expansion.

## What it does

For each content key with a `max_chars` budget, grows the text by 40 percent (rounded up) and fires when the result is over the budget while the source text is within it. A key already over budget is CONTENT002's finding, not this rule's.

## Why it matters

Translations routinely run 30 to 40 percent longer than English. A label that fits by one character in English clips or wraps in German or Finnish.

## Remedy

Shorten the source text, raise the key's `max_chars` after checking the layout can take it, or let the component grow with its content.

## Examples

### A key with no room to grow fires

```toml expect=fire file=design/content/en.toml
locale = "en"

[[key]]
id = "home.cta"
text = "Get started"
max_chars = 12
```

### A key with headroom is clean

```toml expect=clean file=design/content/en.toml
locale = "en"

[[key]]
id = "home.cta"
text = "Get started"
max_chars = 20
```
